remarks: One of Norwalk's best values. This 2-bedroom, 1-bath condo has a spacious living room, eat-in kitchen, and two nice sized bedrooms. Low HOA includes heat and hot water. No rental restrictions and pets are allowed, making it a good option for both investors and owner-occupants. Current tenant pays $2,100 per month and would like to remain if possible. Conveniently located near The SoNo Collection, shopping, restaurants, I-95, East Norwalk train station and Calf Pasture Beach.
